description: ORGANIC Pinterest performance — impressions, saves, Pin clicks, outbound clicks and their rates, for the whole ACCOUNT, for the TOP PINS, for the TOP VIDEO PINS (with view-through and average watch time), or for ONE Pin. This is unpaid reach; paid Pinterest ads have their own report. Use scope:"top_pins" to answer "what is actually working on our Pinterest" — it ranks the account’s own Pins by whichever metric you sort on. NOTE Pinterest keeps only 90 DAYS of organic analytics and refuses a longer window, which is refused here with the reason rather than as an opaque error. A VIDEO Pin takes a different metric set from a static one (pass video:true for scope:"pin"). THERE IS NO BOARD ANALYTICS: Pinterest’s v5 API publishes no such endpoint, so board-level performance genuinely does not exist in any API — do not promise it. An unknown metric is refused by name, and a metric Pinterest omits from a row is MISSING data ("if a column has no value, it may not be returned"), never a measured zero. Works on Pinterest’s Trial access tier — unlike creating Pins, every read row in Pinterest’s access-tier table is available on Trial. Read-only, 0 credits.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

appTypes.description: app type to report on: ALL, MOBILE, TABLET or WEB

metricTypes.description: which metrics; omit for all of the ones valid at this scope. Unknown values are refused with the valid list.

pinId.description: required for scope:"pin" — the id post_to_pinterest returned

since.description: YYYY-MM-DD, default 30 days ago; Pinterest allows at most 90 days back

sortBy.description: top_pins / top_video_pins: the metric to rank by (default the first metric)

splitField.description: account: NO_SPLIT | APP_TYPE | OWNED_CONTENT | SOURCE | PIN_FORMAT

video.description: scope:"pin" only — true when the Pin is a VIDEO, which has its own metric set

name: pinterest_analytics
title: Pinterest organic analytics
